# braintrust_project_group (Resource)

Manages a Braintrust project group. A project may belong to multiple project groups.

For projects also managed by Terraform, leave `member_projects` unset and manage each relationship with `braintrust_project_group_membership`. This ensures Terraform removes membership before destroying the project or group. Inline `member_projects` requires removing membership in a separate apply before destroying a project; do not use both ownership styles for one group.

Adding projects requires `create_acls` on them, and removing projects or deleting a populated group requires `delete_acls`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "org_id" {
  type = string
}

# For projects managed by Terraform, use separate membership resources. Their
# references ensure membership is removed before either the project or group.
resource "braintrust_project" "app" {
  name = "app"
}

resource "braintrust_project_group" "team" {
  org_id      = var.org_id
  name        = "Application team"
  description = "Projects owned by the application team"
}

resource "braintrust_project_group_membership" "app" {
  project_group_id = braintrust_project_group.team.id
  project_id       = braintrust_project.app.id
}

# A project can also be a member of a second project group.
resource "braintrust_project_group" "shared" {
  org_id = var.org_id
  name   = "Shared projects"
}

resource "braintrust_project_group_membership" "shared_app" {
  project_group_id = braintrust_project_group.shared.id
  project_id       = braintrust_project.app.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the project group. Must be unique within the organization.
- `org_id` (String) Organization ID for this project group.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Textual description of the project group.
- `member_projects` (Set of String) Project IDs managed inline. Use separate membership resources for safe simultaneous project deletion.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Date of project group creation.
- `deleted_at` (String) Date of project group deletion, or null if the project group is still active.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the project group (UUID).
- `user_id` (String) Identifies the user who created the project group.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the project group ID.
terraform import braintrust_project_group.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
